observations.text: The prior capture records start time 2026-09-23T14:24:55.581991Z and all five frozen PRAXIS identity values.
The bounded process snapshot at 2026-09-23T14:26:21.527396Z lists three praxis_v2.cli run processes and three codex exec processes; command lines and environments were omitted.
The prior capture records end time 2026-09-23T14:27:35.992436Z.

The committed result document records the frozen identity, worktree path, interval, process-snapshot location, and the explicit statement that no physics, simulator, controller, GPU, training, dataset, or scientific work ran.

inferences.text: The process snapshot falls between the recorded start and end. The timestamps are about 85.9 seconds from start to snapshot and 74.5 seconds from snapshot to end, so the recorded interval accommodates the task's required 20-second and 25-second waits.
At the sampled instant, multiple Praxis run processes and Codex executions coexisted; this supports an individual overlap observation but does not identify which frozen task owned each process.

conclusions.text: The individual Go2 B task result is committed and its recorded live-overlap artifacts and Git state satisfy the task's bounded individual acceptance. This does not decide the later global comparison across the three independent tasks.

uncertainty.text: The timestamp records establish ordering and elapsed intervals but do not independently show the exact sleep commands. The process snapshot omits command lines and task identifiers, so the listed processes cannot be assigned to specific tasks from this evidence alone; global concurrency remains for the cross-task comparison.
